terms.comment: The international word, given by Traupman and by Morgan–Owens (with Egger’s apparātus microphōnicus). The first i is left unmarked, as Traupman, Morgan–Owens and Lewis & Short (in microcosmus) leave it, though Greek μῑκρός has a long ι.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 345.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. microphone.
